**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat` - merges at the cut; Refs #692, correctly not Fixes).

### What looks good
- `crates/ui/src/feature_click.rs` (189 lines) is a thin router: it builds the camera ray (ortho and perspective, per-depth radius), picks the kinds for the armed tool, and calls `pick::pick_selection`. Hover calls the same `feature_at` as click, so hover and click cannot disagree.
- Kinds per tool match the brief (`ask`, lines 58-93): plane row faces only, axis-by-edge edges only, axis-by-points points only, operation geometry by Face/Edge/Vertex mode (Edge adds faces), boundary by mode with a point refused by name (lines 160-164). `through: false` everywhere, so nothing picks through the model.
- Locate (#561) and points (#555) are routed first, in main's order, with the `take` refusals by name kept; the disarm and pre-dock paths are unchanged.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the changed non-test code (diff scan); misses give a status message.
- New `pick/*` modules are all under 400 lines and carry provenance. No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts or dependency changes. No snapshot PNG or `CHANGELOG.md` edits. Body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #692`; a decision record is in `docs/decisions/`.

### Local results (merged with upstream/main c414e01d, clean auto-merge; shared warm target)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| ui lib (CWD `crates/ui`; includes `one_pick_rule`, `vertex_pick_tests`, `setup_picks_disarm`, `locate_tests`) | 449 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| app `feature_pick` | 7 passed |
| app `feature_pick_wire` | 4 passed, 1 ignored (timing lane) |
| app `pick` | 9 passed |
| app `mcp_pick` | 3 passed |
| app `mcp` | 13 passed |
| app `vertex_pick` | 4 passed |
| app `plane_align` | 9 passed |
| app `plane_align_edges` | 5 passed |
| app `axis_align` | 10 passed |
| app `points_align` | 8 passed |
| app `wcs_align` | 5 passed |
| app `face_origin` | 3 passed |
| app `feature` | 18 passed |
| app `fixture_locate` | 11 passed |
| app `fixture_ux` | 9 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` is still 1552 lines (down from 1779); pre-existing size, flagged only.
- The earlier-merge behaviour change (a locate draft in Face mode takes a point within 8 px) is pinned by `locate_and_points_drafts_take_box_corners_as_points`, and the hand check at this head passed per the PR.
- Still owed under #692 (as the body says): pick-through toggle, round-edge centres, WCS anchor markers, docs note.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
